summary: Headroom's main token-savings table (21–57% fewer input tokens on four seeded scenarios, 178,024 → 104,261 tokens in total) is reproducible offline: benchmarks/index_proof_table.py and its committed output benchmarks/results/index_proof_table.txt give the same numbers. The latency, accuracy (GSM8K 0.870 → 0.870; TruthfulQA 0.530 → 0.560, which the README calls no detectable difference), HTML extraction (F1 0.919), tool-search and Vertex AI (76.7% fewer prompt tokens) results have harness code with results recorded in markdown; no raw run files are committed for them, and several need paid API calls. Some README figures differ from the docs: the '0.21 ms p50' matches the docs table's p95 (p50 0.20 ms), and the docs tables from benchmarks/bench_latency.py show a repeated 500-string JSON array at 4.9K → 228 tokens but structured logs at 53% and 54%, against the README's '90%+ on repeated JSON arrays and log lines'. The 40–90% image-compression figure is stated without a benchmark.
